headline: Trash Is King: 3 Medical Waste Stocks Worth a Look
summary: Medical waste was already a booming business before COVID-19, but the surge in coronavirus cases may accelerate the situation. Much of the personal protection equipment (PPE) that healthcare workers use has to be thrown away as medical waste. A Stratistics MRC report says that medical waste is expected to grow into an $18.9 billion market by 2024.
